about: The stroke order the app teaches, against the authorities. tests/test_strokes.py checks the app (src/letters.js, assets/data/hanzi.json, STROKE_NAMES in src/writer.js) against this table, and that every letter and character the app teaches has an entry. See docs/DESIGN.md, 笔顺标准.

letters_authority.name: Zaner-Bloser Handwriting, manuscript: "Manuscript Letter and Numeral Formations" (Practice Masters 113-116, (c) Zaner-Bloser, Inc.)
letters_authority.crosscheck: Learning Without Tears, Capital / Lowercase Formation Chart (c) 2018: https://www.lwtears.com/sites/default/files/2022-01/English_print_letterCharts.pdf
letters_authority.rule: one entry stroke = one Zaner-Bloser numbered stroke (up to its 'Lift.'). path: the stroke's parts in order - down, up, right, left, downleft, downright, upright, upleft (straight), ccw / cw (a curve turning counter-clockwise / clockwise as seen; ZB's back / forward is the way it travels, so ZB's 'curve forward' along the bottom of U is ccw), dot. start: the cell of a 3 x 3 grid over the letter's own box where the stroke begins (T/M/B, L/C/R).

A.zb: 1. Slant left. Lift. 2. Slant right. Lift. 3. Slide right.

B.zb: 1. Pull down straight. Lift. 2. Slide right; curve forward; slide left. Slide right; curve forward; slide left.

D.zb: 1. Pull down straight. Lift. 2. Slide right; curve forward; slide left.

E.zb: 1. Pull down straight. Lift. 2. Slide right. Lift. 3. Slide right; stop short. Lift. 4. Slide right.

F.zb: 1. Pull down straight. Lift. 2. Slide right. Lift. 3. Slide right; stop short.

G.status: FIX: 2 strokes (C + a short push up; the bar slid RIGHT as stroke 2 - the LWT way) -> 1 stroke, circle back then slide left
G.lwt: differs: LWT "Big Curve, Little Line (up), Little Line (across)" numbers the bar as stroke 2, written left to right; ZB followed (one stroke, the bar slides left)

H.zb: 1. Pull down straight. Lift. 2. Pull down straight. Lift. 3. Slide right.

I.zb: 1. Pull down straight. Lift. 2. Slide right. Lift. 3. Slide right.
I.status: FIX: 1 stroke (no top / bottom line) -> 3 strokes

J.zb: 1. Pull down straight; curve back. Lift. 2. Slide right.
J.status: FIX: 1 stroke (no top line) -> 2 strokes, the top line last

K.zb: 1. Pull down straight. Lift. 2. Slant left. Slant right.

M.zb: 1. Pull down straight. Lift. 2. Slant right. Slant up. Pull down straight.

N.zb: 1. Pull down straight. Lift. 2. Slant right. Push up straight.
N.status: FIX: 3 strokes (down; slant right; right side pulled DOWN) -> 2 strokes, slant right + push up straight in one

O.zb: 1. Circle back all the way around.
O.status: START: began at 12 o'clock -> near 1 o'clock (same one counter-clockwise stroke)
O.lwt: same order; LWT starts at the top centre, ZB near 1 o'clock (ZB followed)

P.zb: 1. Pull down straight. Lift. 2. Slide right; curve forward; slide left.

Q.zb: 1. Circle back all the way around. Lift. 2. Slant right.

R.zb: 1. Pull down straight. Lift. 2. Slide right; curve forward; slide left. Slant right.

T.zb: 1. Pull down straight. Lift. 2. Slide right.
T.status: FIX: top line first, then down -> pull down straight first, then slide right

U.zb: 1. Pull down straight; curve forward; push up.

W.zb: 1. Slant right. Slant up. Slant right. Slant up.

Y.zb: 1. Slant right. Lift. 2. Slant left. Pull down straight.
Y.status: FIX: 3 strokes -> 2, the slant left goes on into the pull down
Y.lwt: same order; LWT's 2nd stroke is one long slant (no straight stem)

Z.zb: 1. Slide right. Slant left. Slide right.

a.zb: 1. Circle back all the way around; push up straight. Pull down straight.
a.status: FIX: 2 strokes (circle; a separate line down) -> 1 stroke

b.zb: 1. Pull down straight; push up. Circle forward.

d.zb: 1. Circle back all the way around; push up straight. Pull down straight.
d.status: FIX: 2 strokes (circle; line down from the top line) -> 1 stroke

f.zb: 1. Curve back; pull down straight. Lift. 2. Slide right.

g.zb: 1. Circle back all the way around; push up straight. Pull down straight; curve back.

h.zb: 1. Pull down straight. Push up; curve forward; pull down straight.

j.zb: 1. Pull down straight; curve back. Lift. 2. Dot.

k.zb: 1. Pull down straight. Lift. 2. Slant left. Slant right.

m.zb: 1. Pull down straight. Push up; curve forward; pull down straight. Push up; curve forward; pull down straight.

n.zb: 1. Pull down straight. Push up; curve forward; pull down straight.

o.zb: 1. Circle back all the way around.
o.status: START: began at 12 o'clock -> near 1 o'clock (same stroke)

p.zb: 1. Pull down straight. Push up. Circle forward.

q.zb: 1. Circle back all the way around; push up straight. Pull down straight; curve forward.
q.status: FIX: 2 strokes -> 1 stroke (with ZB's forward curve at the bottom)

r.zb: 1. Pull down straight. Push up; curve forward.

t.zb: 1. Pull down straight. Lift. 2. Slide right.
t.status: SHAPE: the order was right; the stem's hook to the right removed (ZB and LWT t are straight)
t.lwt: same order; LWT starts the stem at the top line

u.zb: 1. Pull down straight; curve forward; push up. Pull down straight.
u.status: FIX: 2 strokes (down-curve-up; a separate line down) -> 1 stroke

w.zb: 1. Slant right. Slant up. Slant right. Slant up.

z.zb: 1. Slide right. Slant left. Slide right.

hanzi_authority.rule: gf: the standard's 序号式 (1 横 2 竖 3 撇 4 点 5 折), read from the standard; page: its page in that PDF (the printed page number is 6 less); names: the stroke names the app says (STROKE_NAMES), each of the class its digit says; starts: where each stroke begins in the app's data (x, y in the 1024 box, y down), checked stroke by stroke against the standard's 跟随式 - it pins the order of strokes of one class (the two 撇 of 火, the four dots of 雨); the test allows 40 units.
